facts.fact: The director general says an interoperability system is being worked on that will let social protection bodies, among others, verify a national ID card's authenticity in real time.

systems.owner: Direction générale de la Population et de la Famille
systems.tiers: social protection bodies named among users

note: Social protection is one named user of a planned ID-verification link; no social registry or programme system is described. Date is the published date.
